name: KitchenOwl
description: KitchenOwl Backend Server. It's mandatory to also install the KitchenOwl-Web Container to access it from mobile and/or web. KitchenOwl is a self-hosted grocery list and recipe manager. The backend is made with Flask and the frontend with Flutter. Easily add items to your shopping list before you go shopping. You can also create recipes and add items based on what you want to cook.
